parsed.summary: The netlist and SPICE deck are internally consistent and reproduce every functional element of the specification (24V input with fuse F2/TVS D6 and a P-MOS reverse-polarity switch T1; TPS62933 buck U4 with a 52.3k/10k FB divider giving ~5V; AZ1117 LDO U6; two ADM3260 isolators U7/U8 each with their own isolated VDD_ISO/GND_ISO and 2.2k pull-ups; three TMC2209 drivers U3/U5/U10 with 110mΩ sense resistors, per-driver 5VOUT/VREF dividers, a shared UART on IO21/IO22 via R27, individual STEP lines on IO11/IO19/IO15, and a shared ~EN on IO20; RTD M3 on the main I2C bus; float interlocks R17/R38/R52/R14 matching the spec's 10k/4.7k network; correct flyback orientation on D1/D2). The reference designators are remapped relative to the specification's labels (e.g. spec U1→netlist U4, spec U3/U4→netlist U7/U8, spec M1→netlist M6), but this is purely cosmetic and changes no connectivity or value, so it does not constitute a behavioural deviation. The known limitations documented in the spec (firmware GPIO mismatch, unwired TF-Luna, DNP BME280/BH1750, absent DS18B20 net) were observed but are explicitly not anomalies. No short, bridged net, wrong component type/value, or rating violation was found.
